source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Sion tops the poll: rural elections with 96 pc"); Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1967, p. 2 ("Poll surprises in many areas")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes and divisions read from the Belfast Telegraph's rural results table of 2 June 1967, checked against the News-Letter of the same date.

note: Triennial election of rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested; the remaining divisions were filled without opposition and their names were not printed in the reports used here. Unionist majority 62; 33 pc poll. The News-Letter printed the division as Hallyrobin and the figures 321 and 259; the Telegraph's figures are used.
